name: lemmi
description: Lemmi's AI plugins for Claude Code (and Codex via .codex-plugin): shared development workflow (skills, project seeding, learnings loop).

plugins.name: lemmi-ai-kit-core
plugins.description: Core development, verification and project learnings. Other workflow families are separate optional plugins.

plugins.name: lemmi-ai-kit-python
plugins.description: Python coding and testing conventions for projects using Lemmi AI Kit Core.

plugins.name: lemmi-ai-kit-research
plugins.description: Source planning, ownership and parallel research workflows.

plugins.name: lemmi-ai-kit-orchestration
plugins.description: Delegation, initiative coordination and stacked-work review workflows. Requires the core pack.

plugins.name: lemmi-ai-kit-skill-authoring
plugins.description: Create, research and review reusable agent skills. Requires the core pack.
